text:
Companion animal travel needs steady, clear handling from the first check-in to boarding.

Companion Animal Travel Desk: Purpose is to guide the shift through safe, compliant companion animal movement across Aurelia Skyways.

When a traveler arrives with a pet, our desk staff verify the reservation details, confirm the animal transport carrier meets our safety expectations, and route the file to processing without delay. For boarding, the traveler must present form "FM-597" at the desk for acceptance. If Coco is involved, note any comfort needs the traveler states and keep those notes attached to the travel file so cabin teams can monitor with consistency.

During the shift, maintain calm communication and keep the travel file current as ground steps change. For incident reporting, the duty role reporting into "Claim Adjudicator" handles any unusual event, records the time line, and ensures all relevant notes are captured before the file leaves desk control.

When a cabin team takes over, confirm the handoff is logged, and remind the traveler about where to wait and how to keep the carrier secured. Coordinate with operations if there are any schedule pressures, and keep the desk workflow predictable for both the traveler and the pet.

If anything goes sideways, document facts clearly and escalate immediately through the internal chain so the next shift can continue without confusion. Contact the senior coordinator for urgent travel file issues and operational escalations.
